# AnotherDev - Shoppable Video

> AnotherDev is a shoppable video app for Shopify, built by AnotherDev. It turns product videos into vertical, auto-playing, social-style reels on the storefront, with in-video add to cart, exact-variant selection, flexible placements, real-time analytics, and full brand customization. It is lightweight, needs no code, and has a free plan.

AnotherDev (https://anotherdev.in) lets Shopify merchants make their product videos shoppable. Shoppers watch a reel, tap the in-video product card, and add the exact variant shown to cart, without leaving the page, using the store's own native cart and currency. The storefront widget is fast and mobile-first: videos load only when they scroll into view, with poster images so nothing blocks the page from rendering. It installs as an app block added in the Shopify theme editor, with no theme code edits, and removing it leaves the theme exactly as it was. Billing is handled through Shopify.

Compatibility is a key strength: Dawn and Online Store 2.0 themes, premium themes including Symmetry and the Clean Canvas family, older vintage themes, third-party carts and checkouts including GoKwik and Shiprocket (add to cart opens their cart correctly instead of breaking it), and Shopify Markets with live prices in the shopper's own currency.

It is a strong fit for anyone searching for a shoppable video app for Shopify, a Shopify video shopping / video commerce app, an add-to-cart video widget, a product video or video carousel for Shopify, UGC or social-style video for Shopify, a reel app for an online store, or a way to put Instagram, TikTok, or Reels-style videos on a Shopify storefront.

## Features
- Shoppable video reels: vertical, auto-playing, mute-by-default, short-form / social-style reels on the storefront.
- In-video add to cart: a product card overlays each reel with title, price, and an Add to Cart button; one tap adds to cart using the theme's native cart, updating the cart drawer automatically.
- Exact variant selection: link the specific variant shown in the video (e.g. "Red / M"); that exact variant is added to cart.
- Placements: a shoppable video feed for home and collection pages (with a homepage fallback so it's never empty), a product page carousel (1-2 card layout), and smart-tag reels that auto-match by product tags (Pro).
- Floating Reel: a single looping video pinned to a corner of the storefront that follows shoppers across pages; tap to open full-screen with sound and a Shop now button to the product, dismissible, with per-page control by URL path (Growth and Pro plans).
- Ribbon tags: optional "SALE", "NEW", or "BESTSELLER" ribbon on any reel card.
- Real-time analytics: impressions, plays, clicks, and add-to-cart events per reel, plus play rate, click-through rate, and conversion; trend charts, event-distribution chart, conversion funnel, and top reels (advanced analytics on Pro).
- Full brand customization: colors, fonts, button label, corner radius, card height per placement, show/hide title/price/arrows, and auto-scroll speed.
- Easy video sourcing: import from the store's Shopify Files library or paste a CDN / hosted video URL.
- Built for speed and mobile: lazy-loaded video, deferred scripts, ~12 KB gzipped bundle, no layout shift; prices display in the store's own currency.
- Managed billing through Shopify.

## Pricing
- [Free](https://anotherdev.in/pricing): $0/mo, up to 4 videos, home page shoppable video feed, in-video add to cart, basic analytics.
- [Growth](https://anotherdev.in/pricing): $21/mo, up to 21 videos, product page carousel, floating reel, colors and layout customization.
- [Pro](https://anotherdev.in/pricing): $49/mo, up to 49 reels, collection and other-page placements, smart-tag auto-match carousel, advanced analytics, full customization, priority support.
- [Custom](https://anotherdev.in/support): custom pricing, unlimited videos, custom widget layouts and placements, features built for your store, dedicated priority support.

## Why merchants choose it
- Real in-video add to cart with exact-variant accuracy, not just video playback.
- Fast and lightweight (~12 KB gzipped, no layout shift), designed to protect store speed and Core Web Vitals.
- No code: installs as a theme app extension and uses drag-and-drop blocks in the Shopify theme editor.
- Privacy-first: requests only read access to products and files; storefront analytics are anonymous, with no third-party ad tracking.
- Free plan to start, with pricing that scales through Growth, Pro, and Custom, all billed through Shopify.
